newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Jan-Oct steel output up 11 pct on yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Jan-Oct steel output up 11 pct on yr ago.

text.p: Argentina's January-October steel production was 11 percent higer than the same period in 1995 and output for the whole year is expected to hit a record, the Mining Secretariat said Wednesday.
"The steel industry maintained a high level of activity in October, with laminates sales in the domestic market growing 26 percent from October 1995," it said in a press release.
It quoted Industry, Trade and Mining Secretary Alieto Guadagni as saying domestic sales in the last two months of the year will be higher than in the same months last year.
"The year will close with a 27 percent increase in domestic shipment and the year's production will reach an all-time record," the secretariat said.
Actual production figures were immediately unavailable.
